title: Hobbit Tavern Beef & Mushroom Stew
description: A slow-simmered, hearty beef stew with three kinds of mushrooms.
ingredients: 1½–2 lb stew beef or cubed chuck roast
Shiitake, baby bella, and white mushrooms (or mixed gourmet mushrooms)
Rosemary, thyme, salt, and black pepper
Optional: Worcestershire sauce; a little butter or cream to finish
steps: Season beef with salt and pepper; brown in batches in a large pot and remove.
Sauté onion, carrots, celery, and mushrooms until softened.
Add garlic and cook 30–60 seconds.
Return beef to pot. Add potatoes, broth, rosemary, thyme, and optional Worcestershire.
Cover and simmer gently for 1½–2 hours, until beef is tender and potatoes are cooked.
Adjust seasoning and optionally finish with a little butter or cream.

title: The Traveler's Loaf
description: Rustic rosemary, thyme, and mozzarella quick bread for soaking up stew.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Mix flour, baking powder, salt, garlic powder, rosemary, and thyme.
Stir in mozzarella and Greek yogurt; add water a tablespoon at a time until a soft dough forms.
Shape a rustic loaf and score the top lightly.
Brush with melted butter and add optional Parmesan, salt, or rosemary.
Bake 25–30 minutes until golden and cooked through; rest 5–10 minutes before slicing.

title: Garlic Cheddar Traveler's Loaf
description: A cheddar variation with the family's jarred diced garlic.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Mix dry ingredients, then stir in cheddar and jarred diced garlic.
Add yogurt and enough water to form a soft dough.
Shape, score, and brush with melted butter.
Bake 25–30 minutes; rest before slicing.

title: The House Butterbeer
description: The established warm A&W cream soda butterbeer with salted caramel flan and silky cold foam.
ingredients: WARM BASE: 2 cans A&W Cream Soda
A small splash of vanilla syrup or extract
COLD FOAM: 1 cup heavy whipping cream
steps: Warm cream soda, caramel syrup, vanilla, and butter over low heat for 5–7 minutes without boiling.
Whip heavy cream, caramel syrup, and vanilla just until silky and pourable, not stiff.
Pour warm butterbeer into four small mugs.
Spoon cold foam over each mug and serve.

title: Frozen Butterbeer
description: A slushy variation inspired by Ami's favorite frozen butterbeer, using the house flavor profile.
ingredients: Small splash vanilla syrup or extract
3–4 cups ice (or cream-soda ice cubes for a less diluted slush)
steps: Blend chilled cream soda, caramel syrup, vanilla, and ice in short bursts until thick and slushy.
Whip cream, caramel syrup, and vanilla to a silky pourable foam.
Divide slush among four glasses and top with cold foam.
For a richer slush, freeze cream soda into cubes ahead of time and use instead of plain ice.

title: Hogwarts Acceptance Letters
description: Nutella-filled pastry envelopes finished with red candy wax seals, based on Ami's shared recipe.
ingredients: Red candy melts for wax seals
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Unroll pie crust and cut into 4–6 rectangles, roughly 4 by 3 inches.
Put 1–2 teaspoons Nutella in the center of each, leaving edges clear.
Fold dough into envelopes: bottom up, sides in, and top into a flap; use dough scraps for triangular flaps if needed.
Press edges with a fork to seal, and brush pastry with beaten egg.
Bake 15–20 minutes until golden brown.
Cool completely; melt red candy melts and pipe a small wax-seal circle onto each envelope. Let set.

title: Rotisserie Buffalo Chicken Wraps
description: Easy meal-prep wraps with buffalo garlic chicken, cheese, and crisp greens.
ingredients: Shredded cooked rotisserie chicken (up to 2 chickens)
About 1 cup Moore's Buffalo Garlic Wing Sauce, to taste
1–2 cups shredded cheddar or Mexican cheese
Optional drizzle: ½ cup Greek yogurt and ¼ cup buffalo sauce
steps: Toss shredded chicken with buffalo garlic sauce, garlic powder, onion powder, and pepper.
Mix optional Greek yogurt drizzle separately.
Fill tortillas with buffalo chicken, shredded cheese, and greens.
Add drizzle or ranch if desired; roll tightly.
For meal prep, keep greens and sauce separate until serving.

title: Elven Garlic Butter
description: Savory garlic and green onion compound butter; no parsley.
steps: Gently sauté garlic and green onions over medium-low heat for 5–7 minutes.
Let mixture cool completely.
Mix into softened butter with salt, pepper, and optional seasonings.
Chill or serve softened with warm bread.

title: Cajun Honey Hearth Butter
ingredients: Black pepper and a tiny pinch of salt
steps: Mix all ingredients into softened butter.
Taste and adjust sweetness or heat.
Serve immediately or chill until needed.
